_comment: The City has renamed service areas, departments, spending categories and
funds several times between FY2011 and FY2027. The published open data keeps
whatever label was in use that year, so a naive year-over-year comparison
shows the same department twice - once ending and once starting - instead of
This file folds historical labels onto the current one. The rule used is:
the canonical name is the FY2027 spelling, because that is what the current
adopted budget document says and a resident checking this page against the
budget book should find the same words. Historical spellings are recorded in
The build script reports any label that does not appear in every fiscal year
and is not listed here, so future renames get noticed rather than silently
Format: field -> { historical label: current label }.
Applied to expenditures, revenues and capital alike.

_publicWorksComment: FY2027 splits the former single Public Works department into three.
Folding them back keeps the department-level comparison continuous; the
drill-down still shows every division underneath, so no detail is lost.
